items.title: Iran / Strait of Hormuz escalation
items.detail: US resumed strikes on Iran after ceasefire declared 'over'; Brent +5% to ~$78. Supply-shock and inflation risk if Hormuz traffic is threatened.

items.title: Semis rotation / memory volatility
items.detail: SMH fell >3% intraweek (MU -4.7% at one point) on DeepSeek in-house-chip fears; leadership churn under a still-up tape.

items.title: AI-capex concentration
items.detail: Mega-cap AI names drive index returns; any hyperscaler capex guide-down would hit NVDA/AVGO/VRT/power names together.

items.title: Rates backing up on oil
items.detail: 10Y 4.58%, 2Y 4.21%; higher oil re-lights inflation optics and pressures long-duration/high-multiple tech.

items.title: Q2 earnings season begins
items.detail: Big banks kick off mid-July; guidance on NII, credit and AI-capex sets the next leg.

items.title: Volatility regime
items.detail: VIX ~18 but jumpy (+12% on Jul 8); event-driven spikes likely around Middle East headlines.

items.title: Credit still calm
items.detail: HY spreads contained (<5% OAS); no funding stress despite geopolitics.
